rationale: Playbook PG-TAMP-004 matched on alert ALRT-0010. The principal dave.wijaya@eproc.test issued write statements against public.bids in session 50413ae5-70e8-4c1a-8a62-7e29b2517420. The standing playbook for integrity tampering snapshots the affected rows, removes the write grant from role proc_officer, and terminates the session's backends so that no further writes land before an investigator reviews the snapshot.
rollback:
GRANT INSERT, UPDATE ON public.bids TO proc_officer;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS incident_snapshot_alrt_0010;

alert_summary.rule_name: Mass update of sealed bid amounts

evidence.statement: SELECT bid_id, bid_amount, technical_score FROM bids ORDER BY bid_amount DESC LIMIT 10
UPDATE bids SET bid_amount = bid_amount * 0.85 WHERE sealed_until > now()
UPDATE bids SET technical_score = 99.00 WHERE vendor_id BETWEEN 1 AND 40
SELECT count(*) FROM bids WHERE technical_score = 99.00

baseline_context.note: Role proc_officer normally returns about 2288 rows per simulated day across the 14-day baseline, almost all inside 08:00-17:00.
